blindness_statement: Membership was determined without consulting any retrieval rank, cross-encoder score, BM25 score, dense score, SYSTEM-H output, or any other system output. The only inputs were the frozen benchmark's own question text and gold span offsets, and chunk membership read from the frozen cs_v1_control chunk table.

method.leakage_clustering: Cases were grouped by union-find over three leakage relations: identical gold span sets, gold spans falling in a shared cs_v1_control chunk, and question-text Jaccard >= 0.34 over content tokens. A cluster is assigned wholesale to one partition.
method.slice_targets: 40% of each slice by largest remainder, giving 8 per slice
method.ordering: Clusters are ordered by sha256(SALT + '|' + '|'.join(sorted case ids)), ties by first case id. SALT is fixed and recorded, so the split is reproducible byte-for-byte from the frozen benchmark alone.
method.assignment: In that order, a cluster goes to validation if every slice it touches still has validation quota; otherwise to reserve.

diagnostic_not_used_for_exclusion.document_level_clustering: Retained as a diagnostic only. Clustering by shared source document would give 40 clusters with the largest holding 10 cases, which is too coarse to partition on: sharing a document is not evidence overlap. Per the coordinator's decision, the exact-gold-span rule remains the governing exclusion rule and no case was excluded for chunk or document overlap.
